purpose: Evidence-backed mapping layer connecting accessories to Parallel Quest acquisition routes while preserving reward-condition, alternate-route, and source conflicts.

verification_policy.indexed: Accessory and PQ relationship identified, but acquisition condition or current-version behavior remains unresolved.
verification_policy.partially_verified: PQ relationship and basic acquisition route are supported, but one or more meaningful conditions, alternate routes, or current-version details remain unresolved.
verification_policy.verified: Accessory identity, PQ source, relevant condition, and applicable alternate-route/version details are reconciled against sufficient independent evidence.

research_rules: A PQ appearing beside an accessory does not automatically establish whether the item is a guaranteed scripted reward, normal reward, Ultimate Finish reward, or random bonus-slot reward.
Normal-clear and Ultimate-Finish acquisition must remain separate fields when evidence supports the distinction.
Alternate shop, raid, gift, wish, and DLC routes are preserved rather than replacing the PQ relationship.
Conflicting historical PQ numbers are retained as source conflicts until independently reconciled.
No drop percentage is inferred from a reward list that does not explicitly document one.
Equipment-set names and accessory names are not conflated; uncertain component relationships remain indexed until the exact inventory item is identified.
A basic reward listing is recorded as a PQ association, not as proof that the item is guaranteed on every clear.
DLC-era PQs are tracked individually so accessory provenance can later be reconciled against DLC, shop, raid, and gift routes.
